title: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell asked to testify to Congress about league’s broadcast deals

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell asked to testify to Congress about league’s broadcast deals
sources.description: The hearing will examine “the extent to which” the law “has been used by the professional sports leagues to harm consumers and whether potential legislative remedies may be needed to address that harm,” Rep. Jordan wrote Goodell.
